profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Mars Science and Diagnostics
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with experience in JavaScript, (Ember, React) and a front-end obsession. I love data, component structure and clean testing. I lead with curiosity, passion, drive and a healthy amount of play. My background in the arts has primed my tech career with empathy and a love for dynamic collaboration. As a queer woman of color, I value diversity of thought, technology and humans; and I love the daily challenge of navigating how that diversity coexists. I am brave in my contributions, have a thirst for learning new tech and embrace failure. I value spending my time away from the computer making time and space to mentor and meet with those pursuing tech.

https://alexramirezdecruz.com/

Lightning Talks:
► Donut.js 2019: "Dynamic Collaboration: Tips and Tools for Coding Collaboratively" - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9yDNvY2rNKc&list=PLclEcT4yxER6PwyVVfJwnD6Vq26tUA-XE&index=1

► PDXWIT 2020: "Claim Your Superpowers!" - 
https://youtu.be/mxTpV7lDGe8

► Languages: JavaScript, Ruby, HTML/CSS
► Front-End: Ember, React, Tailwind, Redux, GlimmerX
► Back-End: Rails, GraphQL, Node.js, Express
► Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase
► Tools: Slack, GitHub, Jira, VScode, Prismic, Shopify, Heroku
► Testing Suites: QUnit, Cypress, Rspec, Semaphore CI, Jest

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
✶ Owned projects from initial planning, costing and implementation through to deployment
  - Lead DTC promotions refactor enabling tiered promotions, free gifts, donations and gift cards, 
     utilizing Ember, Prismic and Shopify Scripts
  - Redesigned brand color system within Tailwind and Prismic
  - Manage Ember/GlimmerX component library
     * Building out new components
     * Clean up/Deprecation of outdated components
     * Write detailed documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
✶ Maintain DTC storefront application (Ember | Tailwind | GlimmerX)
   - Building new features, pages & components
   - Manage/install 3rd party integrations
✶ Supported decoupling DTC progressive web app from a monorepo and the transition to a statically 
    rendered site
✶ Contributed to two successful product launches and three brand refreshes
   - Launched Complete for Cats and Breed Discovery DNA Tests
   - Brand refreshes involved new page structures, components, pages and the integration of new 
      products

positions.title: Software Developer 1
positions.description:
✶ Maintained enterprise application (internal/client facing)
✶ Lead initiative to improve flaky tests
✶ Developed new features and implemented bug fixes
✶ Wrote GraphQL queries to replace inefficient SQL queries
✶ Helped to launch new CMS for prominent client facing pages
✶ Designed reusable React components 
✶ Managed 3rd party connections/data flow through app 
✶ Reviewed pull requests
✶ Contributed to QA testing and application documentation

company.name: The August Wilson Red Door Project

positions.title: Apprentice: Marketing/Outreach Liaison and House Manager

volunteerExperiences.description: I was honored to be selected as a Mars Ambassador and volunteer with our partner organization, Humane World for Animals in AguasCalientes Mexico. I spent 10 days helping with their mobile veterinary clinic.
Got to handle museum specimens, run activities and teach folks of all ages about the museum and the importance of our world's biodiversity.
